scope: Existing S014 evidence and proposed research design only; no economic endorsement.

arithmetic_verification.source: EX031 others/predictions.csv existing A parent rows (216), existing Y1/Y3 and z/environment/year; EX029 existing budget_summary.json (66 accounts).
arithmetic_verification.method: Independently subset stored rows and recompute mean Y1, mean Y3, mean/median Y3-Y1, positive/negative counts; compare all annual counts and winner identities; verify five stored source hashes. No execution of review.py.main.

published_evidence_checks.method: Verify reference dicts equal EX031 result.json; resolve each EvidenceRef and compare bytes with original files.

report_fact_review.finding: Existing labels support closing this continuation hypothesis: up n=37, H1 0.0035821008108109036, H3 -0.005208019189189105, delta -0.008790120000000007; without 2026 up n=28, delta -0.014347780714285736. No conversion into an H1 buy component is justified.

Quoted EX019 log attribution and EX028 common/unique entry counts match referenced account reports. EX024 support_uncapped n=31 mean 0.0178380620, median -0.01339599997, remove-top3 -0.03273655723; pre-2026 n=25 mean -0.00960533353 match stored diagnostics. These are checks of existing summaries, not new account audits.

EX005/007/013/015 already covered broad trend, repair and holding-state questions; EX010 directly tested sector laggard catch-up and its attenuation under stronger stock controls. These are retained as competing evidence.

EX031 design lists B, B+z and B+z_old5 only. The proposed stock-response S and commodity z*S interaction are distinct from those additive models. This is a previously untested structural question within a known delayed-response hypothesis, not a newly supported return mechanism.

design_review.comparison: M2 versus M1 isolates adding the fixed interaction; M1 versus M0 checks additive information. Complete main effects are retained.
design_review.timing: P<T and Q<P, same K at Q/P, S uses Q-to-T HFQ closes available at T close, execution after T. Report requires actual Q stock close and prohibits fill or date substitution. Actual Q coverage remains an authorized implementation/preparation check, not established by this proposal review.
design_review.identification: Four-cell contrast and both absolute net return and allocation comparisons are specified. Conditional prediction is distinguished from causal effect, low valuation and proof of unreacted information.
design_review.budget: 12 proposed fixed fits, failures counted, no automatic rerun; not authorized by this review. No additional labels, upstream data or accounts proposed.
design_review.objectives: Original fees, execution, full-long account, annual return/drawdown and full-window frequency remain unchanged. At least 83 closures is ceil(1642*3/60), not an added performance target.
design_review.limits: All historical data have been seen. Negative controls and subgroup robustness are diagnostics, not new per-year same-sign or significance economic gates. No inference that a positive subgroup or model comparison is sufficient for an account.

conclusion: Review goal achieved. Proposal is coherent for a separately authorized bounded test; no positive-return support or effective component has been established.
limitations: Did not re-audit all historical models or 66 account ledgers.
Did not independently reopen external primary announcements; business-link discussion is only a hypothesis-generating rationale.
This artifact records reviewed evidence and design correctness, not new experiment authorization or economic success.
